wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 12-001 aggregates the default.cfg + chocolate-doom.cfg parse/create, the vanilla-format write-back (M_SaveDefaults), and the test-isolation policy into a single src/vanilla re-export facade for the launch config path. The two config files are disjoint namespaces (no shared variable, no precedence conflict). The read-only src/config/ modules already implement Chocolate Doom 2.2.1 m_config.c semantics; pure barrel + frozen manifest, no source modification.
